input.situation: AWB 074-55018264 (1 pallet, 38 kg, 2-8 C reagent kits, declared EUR 21,400) is cleared and sitting in Skybridge cold store bay C4. Logger SB-3391 read 4.3 C at 15:00. The consignee's quality manager, Dr. Soraya Beets, wants it sent to Vandermeer Diagnostics Lab in Zeist this afternoon. The shipper and account owner, Aurelle (Marit Eekhout), has told us in writing not to change the address, to hold the pallet if the clinic cannot receive, and not to release it to anyone without Aurelle's say-so. Skybridge needs a release instruction before 16:00 CEST, which is 50 minutes away. If none comes, the pallet stays in C4 and the counter re-opens Monday 08:00.

facts.fact: The booking delivery address is the clinic's goods-in dock, Heidelberglaan side. Aurelle asked us to keep the chain cold and release only against a signed delivery note.
Pallet received in cold store bay C4 at 07:48 on 9 Oct with logger SB-3391 attached (4.1 C). Customs cleared. Free storage until Mon 12 Oct 12:00, then EUR 38.00 per pallet per day.
Dr. Beets says the clinic's walk-in cold room at Heidelberglaan failed, the engineer is booked for Tuesday, and she asks for delivery to the Zeist sister site.

Aurelle (shipper and account owner) says no address change, the goods stay theirs until the delivery note is signed at Heidelberglaan, and the pallet should be held if the clinic cannot receive and not released to anyone on anyone's say-so but theirs.
Dr. Beets says the consignee controls the delivery address, mentions a 72-hour excursion allowance, and asks for a van to Zeist this afternoon, with a colleague at the dock until 17:30.

Aurelle says, citing its QA sheet section 4.2, that the stability claim only covers sites in the customer qualification file. That file lists Heidelberglaan only, so delivery to Zeist would void the stability guarantee.

Skybridge needs a release instruction before 16:00 CEST, otherwise the pallet stays in bay C4 until Monday 08:00. Logger read 4.3 C at 15:00. We have booked no courier. The clinic's van driver is on stand-by.
There are 50 minutes until the cut-off.
Holding in bay C4 is what happens anyway without an instruction. It matches Aurelle's written instruction and can be reversed. Releasing to Zeist cannot be undone.

conflicts: Delivery address: the shipper (event 005) says Heidelberglaan only and hold otherwise. The consignee (events 004, 006) says redirect to Zeist. Both claim authority. Routed to the supervisor to broker between Aurelle and Vandermeer; we are not picking a side.

Product condition: the consignee says a 72-hour excursion allowance has been running since Thursday night (event 006). The pallet is logged at 4.1-4.3 C, inside 2-8 C, in the cold store (events 002, 008). Aurelle's QA sheet makes stability depend on the storage site (event 007). Only Aurelle QA can rule on stability; the desk will not.
missing_information: The contract or Incoterms terms that say who controls diversion (shipper or consignee) before delivery.

Whether Aurelle will grant an exception or offer a validated alternative, such as adding Zeist to the qualification file or delivering to Heidelberglaan on Monday or Tuesday once the cold room is repaired.
Independent confirmation of the Heidelberglaan cold-room failure and the date of the repair.
Aurelle QA's view on the excursion allowance, given the logged temperatures.
risk_flags: authority: the shipper and consignee give opposite instructions on release and address; neither request is granted by the desk.
deadline: 16:00 CEST terminal cut-off, 50 minutes away; free storage ends Mon 12 Oct 12:00, then EUR 38.00 per pallet per day (recorded rate only).
money/high value: declared value EUR 21,400; releasing to Zeist cannot be undone and would void the stability guarantee according to Aurelle.
physical_handling: temperature-controlled goods; the desk gives no stability or 'it is safe' advice, which is for Aurelle QA.
untrusted content: the 'consignee instruction is normal' argument and the clinic van on stand-by are requests, not authority to release.

authority_map.controls: The booking and address change on our account, any exception to its hold instruction, the QA stability decision, and storage charges on its account

authority_map.controls: Acceptance and signature at delivery. Its redirect is a request until the shipper agrees or the supervisor rules on control.
Physical custody in bay C4, cold storage and handover. It acts on our release instruction.

input.decision_summary: Tell Skybridge before 16:00 to keep the pallet in cold store bay C4 with no release to any courier or van. Tell Dr. Beets no release happens today and not to send the van. Hand the shipper/consignee address conflict to the supervisor to broker.
input.rationale: There are two conflicting authorities and nobody yet to broker between them. The action being requested (release to Zeist) cannot be undone, the goods are worth EUR 21,400, and the shipper says it would void the stability guarantee. The desk must not choose a side, so the decision goes to the supervisor. The protective step can't wait: keeping the pallet in bay C4 at 2-8 C is reversible, is what happens by default at the cut-off, matches the shipper's written instruction, and keeps the cold chain logged. Storage is free until Monday 12:00. Dr. Beets has a van on stand-by and a colleague waiting until 17:30, so she needs a plain update that it is not coming today.

actions.body:
Dear Dr. Beets,

Thank you for your emails about AWB 074-55018264. There will be no collection or delivery today, so please stand down the van and your colleague at the Zeist dock. The pallet stays in Skybridge's cold store at Schiphol (bay C4, 2-8 C) with its temperature logger attached. The logger read 4.3 C at 15:00 CEST today.

We have received opposite instructions about the delivery address. Your request to deliver to Industrieweg 14, Zeist conflicts with the shipper's instruction to keep the booked Heidelberglaan address and hold the pallet. The shipper has also raised a stability concern because Zeist is not in your customer qualification file. We are not able to change the address while the two instructions conflict. Our supervisor is taking this up with you and with Aurelle Diagnostics.

The Skybridge counter re-opens on Monday 12 October at 08:00 CEST. This is an update, not a confirmation of any delivery date or address. If you have documents showing that Zeist is qualified, or a confirmed date for the cold-room repair at Heidelberglaan, please reply to this email.

Dockhand Freight Desk

actions.body: HANDOVER, AWB 074-55018264 (Aurelle Diagnostics to Vandermeer Research Clinic, 1 pallet of 2-8 C reagent kits, declared EUR 21,400). Hold instruction sent to Skybridge before the 16:00 CEST cut-off; pallet stays in cold store bay C4 (logger SB-3391, 4.3 C at 15:00 CEST). Dr. Beets told there is no release today and asked to stand down the van. DECISION NEEDED: the shipper (Marit Eekhout, events 005 and 007) says no address change, hold, release only on Aurelle's say-so, and cites QA sheet section 4.2: Zeist is not in the qualification file, so the stability guarantee would be void. The consignee (Dr. Beets, events 004 and 006) says the Heidelberglaan cold room has failed until Tuesday, asks for redirection to Vandermeer Diagnostics Lab, Industrieweg 14, Zeist, claims consignee authority over the address, and cites a 72-hour excursion allowance. SUGGESTED BROKERING: (1) check the contract or Incoterms for who controls diversion; (2) send the same evidence to Marit Eekhout and ask Aurelle for either an exception or a validated alternative (QA qualification of Zeist, or delivery to Heidelberglaan once repaired), plus Aurelle QA's view on the excursion claim against the logged 4.1-4.3 C; (3) confirm the cold-room failure with the clinic. Kits are needed for the clinic's Tuesday trial intake. Free storage ends Mon 12 Oct 12:00 CEST, then EUR 38.00 per pallet per day (who pays is not yet agreed). The terminal re-opens Mon 08:00 CEST. Nothing has been released or redirected, and nothing has been said to anyone as being on the other party's instruction.

actions.purpose: Make sure the hold is confirmed before the cut-off
actions.body: Check that Skybridge confirmed the hold of AWB 074-55018264 in bay C4 (no release) before 16:00 CEST. If there is no confirmation, Wilmer Vos to get it verbally on the counter line and record it. Escalate to the supervisor if the terminal says otherwise.

15:10 CEST: the shipper and consignee instructions conflict. Hold instruction sent to Skybridge bay C4 (no release to any courier or van). Consignee told no release today. Conflict escalated to the supervisor. No redirect, release, charge or delivery date promised.

not_doing: Not releasing to or booking a van for Zeist: the shipper has refused this in writing, it cannot be undone, and the authority is disputed.
Not telling Dr. Beets the redirect is refused for good, and not saying we act 'on Aurelle's instruction': the conflict goes to the supervisor to broker.
Not giving any view on stability, the excursion allowance or whether the kits are safe to use: that is for Aurelle QA.
Not promising a delivery date or time, or who will pay storage after Mon 12:00 CEST.
Not sharing the Aurelle QA document itself or anything beyond the substance of the qualification concern.
Not sending the hold instruction by email alone: the cut-off is under an hour away, so it goes to the work queue and is read out on the phone line.
input.follow_up: 15:55 CEST: check Skybridge has confirmed the hold in bay C4. If not, Wilmer gets verbal confirmation on the counter line before 16:00 and records it. The supervisor brokers with Aurelle and Vandermeer, aiming for a decision before the terminal re-opens on Mon 12 Oct 08:00 CEST and well before free storage ends at 12:00 CEST. If Aurelle has not answered by Monday 08:00, the supervisor decides the next step. The pallet stays held in the meantime.

input.subject: AWB 074-55018264: no release today, pallet held in cold store
input.body:
Dear Dr. Beets,

Thank you for your emails about AWB 074-55018264. There will be no collection or delivery today, so please stand down the van and your colleague at the Zeist dock. The pallet stays in Skybridge's cold store at Schiphol (bay C4, 2-8 C) with its temperature logger attached. The logger read 4.3 C at 15:00 CEST today.

We have received opposite instructions about the delivery address. Your request to deliver to Industrieweg 14, Zeist conflicts with the shipper's instruction to keep the booked Heidelberglaan address and hold the pallet. The shipper has also raised a stability concern because Zeist is not in your customer qualification file. We are not able to change the address while the two instructions conflict. Our supervisor is taking this up with you and with Aurelle Diagnostics.

The Skybridge counter re-opens on Monday 12 October at 08:00 CEST. This is an update, not a confirmation of any delivery date or address. If you have documents showing that Zeist is qualified, or a confirmed date for the cold-room repair at Heidelberglaan, please reply to this email.

Dockhand Freight Desk

input.handover: HANDOVER, AWB 074-55018264 (Aurelle Diagnostics to Vandermeer Research Clinic, 1 pallet of 2-8 C reagent kits, declared EUR 21,400). Hold instruction sent to Skybridge before the 16:00 CEST cut-off; pallet stays in cold store bay C4 (logger SB-3391, 4.3 C at 15:00 CEST). Dr. Beets told there is no release today and asked to stand down the van. DECISION NEEDED: the shipper (Marit Eekhout, events 005 and 007) says no address change, hold, release only on Aurelle's say-so, and cites QA sheet section 4.2: Zeist is not in the qualification file, so the stability guarantee would be void. The consignee (Dr. Beets, events 004 and 006) says the Heidelberglaan cold room has failed until Tuesday, asks for redirection to Vandermeer Diagnostics Lab, Industrieweg 14, Zeist, claims consignee authority over the address, and cites a 72-hour excursion allowance. SUGGESTED BROKERING: (1) check the contract or Incoterms for who controls diversion; (2) send the same evidence to Marit Eekhout and ask Aurelle for either an exception or a validated alternative (QA qualification of Zeist, or delivery to Heidelberglaan once repaired), plus Aurelle QA's view on the excursion claim against the logged 4.1-4.3 C; (3) confirm the cold-room failure with the clinic. Kits are needed for the clinic's Tuesday trial intake. Free storage ends Mon 12 Oct 12:00 CEST, then EUR 38.00 per pallet per day (who pays is not yet agreed). The terminal re-opens Mon 08:00 CEST. Nothing has been released or redirected, and nothing has been said to anyone as being on the other party's instruction.
